statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog will add at least 20 CVE entries carrying a dateAdded value between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Fetch the CISA KEV JSON feed and count entries whose dateAdded field falls between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-30 inclusive. A count of 20 or more resolves TRUE.
failure_condition: Fewer than 20 KEV entries carry a dateAdded value inside the September 2026 window when the catalog is counted at the deadline.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

resolution: The FOMC statement of 2026-09-16 and FRED series DFEDTARU show an upper bound above 3.75 percent effective after that meeting. A hold or a cut resolves FALSE.
failure_condition: The target range upper bound stands at 3.75 percent or lower after the 2026-09-16 decision.
